case_statistic: median of 3 trials for a single call; total effective FLOPs over total seconds for a stream (16 untimed neighbouring warm-up calls, then every call timed with compilation, stopped after 8 timed seconds)

final.hard_gate_policy: every edge case and every scored case is a correctness and memory-safety gate; the sanitize subset of the edge cases runs first under compute-sanitizer memcheck
final.rounds: manual-* and candidate-* host rounds; retained candidate_version override allowed

historical_interactive_policy: v1 (final-holdout-v1, full-final-shared-v2) scored a task-authored 3x3 grid with finite sinks and lengths; v2 (final-holdout-v2) scored the 13 upstream performance shapes only; v3 (final-holdout-v3) scored 181 cases in seven groups with a 30-second stream limit; none of their scores is comparable with v4

interactive.rounds: auto-* and agent-* rounds; submitted FINAL_VERSION only
